name: M'ONDUNIQ luxury vitamin cocktail with caviar
shortDescription: Premium active-ingredient concentrate with caviar extract, stabilised vitamin C, niacinamide and silk proteins. 10 × 3 ml sterile ampoules for dull, tired and mature skin.
description:
Caviar extract is one of the most valuable ingredients in luxury skincare – the M'ONDUNIQ luxury vitamin cocktail with caviar combines it with stabilised vitamin C, niacinamide, vitamins E, B5 and B6, and hydrolysed silk proteins. The aim of this premium professional active-ingredient concentrate is to intensively revitalise, nourish and brighten the skin.

Caviar extract itself is extremely rich in essential amino acids, proteins, vitamins and minerals, which support the skin's natural regeneration and contribute to a firmer, healthier appearance. The carefully formulated vitamin complex provides powerful antioxidant protection while helping restore the skin's hydration, elasticity and natural radiance.

The stabilised vitamin C and niacinamide in the formula are primarily responsible for a more even, radiant skin tone: together, these two outstanding active ingredients of modern professional skincare support the skin's natural renewal, help reduce the appearance of a dull, lifeless complexion, and may help make uneven pigmentation caused by sun damage or ageing less noticeable.

Thanks to its rich formula, it is an ideal choice for the professional treatment of dull, tired, dehydrated or mature skin, as well as skin that has lost its glow or has a slightly uneven tone – especially as part of revitalising and anti-aging protocols aimed at a more radiant, fresher and more even complexion. After the treatments, the skin looks fresher, plumper, more revitalised and feels silkier to the touch.

Thanks to its sterile, professional design, it fits perfectly into modern aesthetic treatment protocols. Its vitamin, antioxidant and amino acid content is especially beneficial in treatments that increase the skin's ability to absorb active ingredients: it is recommended for professional microneedling mesotherapy (Dermapen, Biopen), nano needling, electroporation, oxygen infusion, cold plasma, ultrasonic and radiofrequency microneedling treatments, as well as after hydrodermabrasion treatments.

During microneedling treatments, the skin temporarily has an increased ability to absorb active ingredients: at such times, the concentrated formula provides an intensive supply of vitamins and nutrients, while supporting the skin's hydration, comfort and natural regeneration. Thanks to the combined action of caviar extract, stabilised vitamin C, niacinamide and silk proteins, the skin can look more revitalised, plumper, more radiant and more youthful.

Size: 10 × 3 ml sterile professional ampoules.

faq.question: Which professional treatments is the vitamin cocktail recommended for?
faq.answer: Thanks to its sterile, concentrated formula, it is recommended for professional microneedling mesotherapy (Dermapen, Biopen), nano needling, electroporation, oxygen infusion, cold plasma and radiofrequency microneedling treatments, ultrasonic active-ingredient delivery, as well as after hydrodermabrasion treatments. It also works well as part of luxury revitalising and anti-aging protocols.

faq.question: What does the package contain?
faq.answer: The box contains 10 sterile professional ampoules, each with 3 ml of active-ingredient concentrate.

faq.question: Which skin type is it primarily recommended for?
faq.answer: It is made for the professional treatment of dull, tired, dehydrated or mature skin, as well as skin that has lost its glow or has a slightly uneven tone, where the goal is a more radiant, fresher and more even complexion.

faq.question: When is it best used in the treatment protocol?
faq.answer: It is most beneficial when the skin's ability to absorb active ingredients is temporarily increased – for example during a microneedling treatment – or after a hydrodermabrasion treatment, as an active-ingredient boost.

faq.question: Which active ingredients are responsible for a more even skin tone?
faq.answer: Primarily stabilised vitamin C and niacinamide: together, they support the skin's natural renewal and may help make uneven pigmentation caused by sun damage or ageing less noticeable. In addition, caviar extract and the antioxidant active ingredients support a fresh, youthful appearance of the skin.

faq.question: What does caviar extract add to the treatment?
faq.answer: Caviar extract is extremely rich in essential amino acids, proteins, vitamins and minerals, which support the skin's natural regeneration and contribute to a firmer, healthier appearance. It nourishes the skin with essential amino acids, vitamins and minerals, while, together with antioxidant active ingredients, it supports a healthy, fresh and youthful appearance.

faq.question: What will the client experience after the treatment?
faq.answer: After the treatments, the skin looks fresher, plumper, more revitalised and feels silkier to the touch. The product enhances the skin's natural radiance and can result in velvety soft, silky skin.
